title: Conditional Optimal Bridge for Riemannian Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2607.10517v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for controlling large language models at inference time. Many existing steering methods implicitly optimize a log-density-ratio objective between desired and undesired activation distributions without a principled derivation. Methods with fixed steering directions can also degrade out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. We introduce Conditional Optimal Bridge for Riemannian Activation Steering (\textsc{Cobras}), which casts steering as a Schr\"{o}dinger Bridge on the residual-stream hypersphere. This formulation yields a principled derivation of the log-density-ratio steering objective from a well-posed optimization problem. We construct a query-adaptive steering field that recovers log-density-ratio steering as a limiting case. The fitted transport also provides a support score for controlling OOD interventions. translated_title: 面向黎曼激活引导的条件最优桥
translated_abstract: 激活引导为在推理阶段控制大型语言模型提供了一种轻量级的微调替代方案。许多现有的引导方法隐式地优化期望与不期望激活分布之间的对数密度比目标，但缺乏有原则的推导。而采用固定引导方向的方法在分布外（OOD）场景下性能也可能下降。我们提出了用于黎曼激活引导的条件最优桥（COBRAS），该方法将引导建模为残差流超球面上的薛定谔桥问题。这一表述使得对数密度比引导目标能够从一个适定的优化问题中得到有原则的推导。我们构建了一个查询自适应的引导场，将对数密度比引导作为其极限情形加以恢复。拟合的传输还为控制OOD干预提供了支撑分数。在四个模型上，COBRAS的性能优于先前的引导方法。
tldr: 该论文提出COBRAS方法，将激活引导建模为残差流超球面上的薛定谔桥问题，从适定的优化问题出发有原则地推导出对数密度比引导目标，并通过查询自适应的引导场和支撑分数控制分布外干预，在多个模型上优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes COBRAS, which formulates activation steering as a Schrödinger Bridge on the residual-stream hypersphere, principledly derives the log-density-ratio steering objective from a well-posed optimization problem, and employs a query-adaptive steering field with a support score to control OOD interventions, outperforming prior methods across four models.
